name: Codex CLI

requirements.hint: Install Rust with rustup from https://rustup.rs; rustup picks up the toolchain each release pins
Install Rust with rustup from https://rustup.rs

build: cd codex-rs && sed -i.open-mods.bak '1,/^version = "/s/^version = "[^"]*"/version = "'"${OPEN_MODS_VERSION}+${OPEN_MODS_MODS}"'"/' Cargo.toml && rm -f Cargo.toml.open-mods.bak && cargo build --release -p codex-cli --bin codex
